text:
noah: Heads-up: billing policy tweaks go live 2026-07-01. Short list below and comms plan.

anya: Key changes?

noah: 1) New default free-trial for new accounts: $50 credits (down from previous). 2) Introduce "surge buffer" — temporary non-billable cushion to absorb brief spikes; visible in console. 3) Overage grace window reduced to 7 days. 4) Invoices will show per-model charge lines and a surge line when buffer used.

billing-bot: Migration tasks queued: free_credit_update, surge_buffer_toggle, invoice_line_items. Billing service rollout scheduled 2026-06-24 01:00 UTC.

ops-bot: Note: rollout may recompute pending invoices; expect short index rebuild. Monitor: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/bs-345.

frank: Will admins be able to opt-out of the surge buffer? Some enterprise customers want strict controls.

noah: Yes — org admins can disable surge buffer or set per-org buffer sizes via Console > Billing. Dedicated/contracted customers unaffected unless they opt in.

anya: Communications: customer email + console banner + help center FAQ. Drafts to legal and CS tomorrow.

frank: Add webhook event when a key enters SURGE state and when buffer is consumed. Ops wants early alerts.

billing-bot: Added webhook events: quota_state (NORMAL|SURGE|OVERAGE) and billing.surge_used. Also emit quota_warning at 80%.

noah: Thanks all. I'll post the final email and banner copy once legal signs off.

anya: ack :thumbsup:
